metadata.name: trellis_capacity
metadata.description: Trellis Bushels: bond-backed prepaid capacity commitments and key-bound lots, plus the write-only HVX feed (Backend spec section 5.6)

instructions.name: build_profile
docs: Anyone: the floors compiled into this binary (profile 0 = mainnet, 1 = devnet), as return data.

instructions.name: buy_lot
docs: Sale authority records a purchase bound to `key_hash`. No transfer exists.

instructions.name: claim_lot_shortfall
docs: Authority files `price_paid * unserved / tokens` against the host's bond; all claims of a commitment together
stay within its value, and the bond pays them out of what the commitment locked.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pays the rent of the bond proposal.

accounts.name: slash_ledger
docs: pending against the bond's headroom.

accounts.name: bond_lock
docs: amount out of it and refuses a claim larger than what is locked.

instructions.name: commit_capacity
docs: Host records a bond-backed capacity commitment.

accounts.name: bond_config
docs: `trellis_bond` config (for `min_bond`). `Account<..>` enforces the owner is `trellis_bond`.

accounts.name: host_bond
docs: The host's bond; must be active and have enough headroom for this commitment.

accounts.name: slash_ledger
docs: claims still open against the bond from it.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The initial authority. In production this is a Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig. Must be the program's upgrade
authority, so nobody else can initialise the program between deploy and init.

instructions.name: migrate_commitment
docs: Grows a commitment created by an earlier version to the current layout (anyone may pay; works once).

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: Grows a config created by an earlier version to the current layout (anyone may pay; works once).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Guardian or authority: pause for `PAUSE_TTL` (72h). A guardian pause cannot be repeated for 7 days.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: Authority: record any config change (including an authority hand-over); it can be applied after
`CONFIG_TIMELOCK` (24h).

instructions.name: publish_hvx
docs: HVX authority publishes the hourly index (never for a future hour). Nothing settles against it.

instructions.name: redeem_lot
docs: Sale authority marks a lot redeemed; credits are issued off-chain against the event.

instructions.name: rehome_lot
docs: Authority honours a lot's unserved share on another host of the same grade.

accounts.name: replacement
docs: Open commitment on another host, same grade, that will serve the unserved tokens.

instructions.name: release_commitment
docs: Anyone, after `window_end + CLAIM_PERIOD`: settle a commitment and release its bond lock.

accounts.name: bond_lock
docs: another (empty) account to settle a commitment without releasing its lock.

instructions.name: report_shortfall
docs: Authority reports unserved tokens after `window_end` (0 settles the commitment).

accounts.name: bond_lock
docs: another (empty) account to settle a commitment without releasing its lock.

instructions.name: resolve_config
docs: `apply = true`: the authority installs the pending change after the timelock (a new authority must co-sign).
`apply = false`: the authority drops it (the guardian cannot); anyone may clear an expired one.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Applying or cancelling: the authority. Anyone may clear a proposal that has expired.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: Required only when the pending change hands the authority over: the new authority must sign to take it.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Authority only.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Authority: tightening only (a lower issuance cap), effective at once. Loosening is refused (`RequiresTimelock`).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the program authority

errors.name: NotSaleAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the sale authority

errors.name: NotHvxAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the HVX authority

errors.name: NotGuardian
errors.msg: Signer is neither the guardian nor the authority

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: New commitments and sales are paused

errors.name: InvalidGrade
errors.msg: Unknown grade (expected 0 = G-S, 1 = G-M, 2 = G-L)

errors.name: ZeroPrice
errors.msg: Grade price must be greater than zero

errors.name: ZeroTokens
errors.msg: Tokens must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: Window end must be after window start and in the future

errors.name: BondHostMismatch
errors.msg: Host bond does not belong to this host

errors.name: BondInactive
errors.msg: Host bond is not active (under-funded, unbonding, delisted or ejected)

errors.name: ExceedsBondHeadroom
errors.msg: Commitment value exceeds the host's remaining bond headroom

errors.name: ExceedsIssuanceCap
errors.msg: Commitment value exceeds the global issuance cap

errors.name: CommitmentNotOpen
errors.msg: Commitment is not open

errors.name: WindowEnded
errors.msg: Commitment window has ended; no more sales

errors.name: WindowNotEnded
errors.msg: Commitment window has not ended yet

errors.name: InsufficientCapacity
errors.msg: Not enough unsold capacity in this commitment

errors.name: LotIdMismatch
errors.msg: Lot id must equal the commitment's next lot id

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price paid must be greater than zero and at most the list price

errors.name: InvalidKeyHash
errors.msg: Key hash must not be all zeros

errors.name: AlreadyRedeemed
errors.msg: Lot already redeemed

errors.name: UnservedExceedsCommitted
errors.msg: Unserved tokens exceed committed tokens

errors.name: NoShortfall
errors.msg: Commitment has no reported shortfall

errors.name: LotAlreadyHandled
errors.msg: Lot shortfall already claimed or rehomed

errors.name: InvalidReplacement
errors.msg: Replacement commitment must be a different, open commitment of the same grade

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: Nothing to claim for this lot

errors.name: HvxHourNotMonotonic
errors.msg: HVX hour must not go backwards

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: RequiresTimelock
errors.msg: This change loosens a safety parameter: use propose_config and apply_config after the timelock

errors.name: TimelockNotElapsed
errors.msg: The timelock has not elapsed

errors.name: WindowTooLong
errors.msg: Window is longer, or ends further away, than this program allows

errors.name: ClaimPeriodNotElapsed
errors.msg: The claim period after the window has not elapsed

errors.name: CommitmentSettled
errors.msg: Commitment is already settled

errors.name: InvalidConfigValue
errors.msg: Invalid configuration value

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.msg: The proposal expired; cancel it and propose again

errors.name: GuardianCooldown
errors.msg: The guardian paused recently and must wait before pausing again; the authority can pause at any time

errors.name: AlreadyMigrated
errors.msg: The account already has the current layout

errors.name: NotMigratable
errors.msg: The account is not one this instruction migrates

errors.name: ExceedsCommitmentValue
errors.msg: The lots recorded against a commitment cannot be worth more than the commitment

errors.name: ClaimExceedsCommitment
errors.msg: The claims filed for a commitment cannot exceed the commitment's value

errors.name: HvxHourInFuture
errors.msg: HVX hour is in the future

errors.name: OutOfBounds
errors.msg: Value is outside the bounds this program enforces

types.name: BondConfig
docs: Program configuration. Production `authority` is a Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig;
`guardian` (a separate key, held by neither the operator nor the multisig) can only pause new bonds, never move funds.

fields.name: slasher
docs: Account allowed to open slash proposals (the `slasher` service, behind the multisig).

fields.name: refund_pool
docs: Token account that receives the share of a slash earmarked for affected callers.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Token account that receives the remainder of a slash.

fields.name: capacity_claimer
docs: PDA of `trellis_capacity` allowed to file capacity-shortfall claims via CPI.

fields.name: capacity_refund
docs: Token account that receives capacity-shortfall payouts (purchase price of unserved Bushels).

fields.name: paused_until
docs: When the pause lapses by itself (`PAUSE_TTL` after it was last set). `paused` is in force only until then.

fields.name: guardian_pause_ready_at
docs: The guardian may not pause again before this time (`GUARDIAN_PAUSE_COOLDOWN` after its last pause was due to
lapse).

types.name: BuildProfile
docs: What `build_profile` returns: the floors compiled into this binary.

fields.name: profile
docs: 0 = mainnet floors (the default build); 1 = the `devnet` cargo feature.

types.name: BushelLot
docs: A purchase ledger entry. Bound to `key_hash`; there is no transfer instruction.

fields.name: key_hash
docs: Hash of the buyer's API key; redemption is only ever issued to this key.

fields.name: price_paid
docs: USDC the buyer actually paid. The only figure a refund can ever reference. At most the lot's share of the
commitment at the price the commitment was made at, and all lots of a commitment together at most its `value`.

fields.name: shortfall_claimed
docs: Set once a shortfall claim for this lot has been filed against the host's bond.

fields.name: refund_amount
docs: `price_paid * unserved_tokens / commitment.tokens` filed as the bond claim.

fields.name: rehomed_to
docs: Commitment on another host of the same grade that honours the unserved part, if any.

fields.name: host_bond
docs: `trellis_bond::HostBond` backing this commitment.

fields.name: tokens
docs: Output-equivalent tokens committed inside the window.

fields.name: sold_tokens
docs: Tokens sold as lots so far (including rehomed-in tokens).

fields.name: value
docs: `tokens * grade_price / TOKENS_PER_BUSHEL` (ceil) at the price of the moment the host committed; locked in the
bond. Never changes afterwards.

fields.name: unserved_tokens
docs: Tokens the host failed to serve, as reported by the authority after `window_end`.

fields.name: lots_sold
docs: Number of lots sold; also the next `lot_id`.

fields.name: price_per_bushel
docs: The grade's price per Bushel when the host made this commitment. A lot recorded against it can never be priced
above this, whatever the grade price is changed to later (security review round 3, R3-16). 0 on a commitment
from before the field existed (`migrate_commitment`): nothing more is sold against such a commitment.

fields.name: paid_total
docs: Sum of `price_paid` of the lots recorded against this commitment. Never above `value`.

fields.name: claimed_value
docs: Sum of the shortfall claims filed against the host's bond for this commitment. Never above `value`; it is the
part of the commitment's bond lock that the claims took, so `release_commitment` unlocks `value - claimed_value`.

types.name: CapacityConfig
docs: Program configuration. Production `authority` is a Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig;
`guardian` (a separate key, held by neither the operator nor the multisig) can only pause new commitments and sales, never move funds.

fields.name: sale_authority
docs: Records sales and redemptions (the `mint`/settlement service key).

fields.name: hvx_authority
docs: The only key allowed to write `HvxFeed`.

fields.name: grade_prices
docs: Fixed USDC price per Bushel (per 1M tokens) for each grade, each at most `MAX_GRADE_PRICE`. A new commitment is
valued at it and keeps it; sales never exceed it nor the price their commitment was made at.

fields.name: max_outstanding_value
docs: Cap on the USDC value of all open commitments. At most `MAX_OUTSTANDING_VALUE_CAP`.

fields.name: outstanding_value
docs: USDC value of all currently open commitments.

fields.name: paused_until
docs: When the pause lapses by itself (`PAUSE_TTL` after it was last set). `paused` is in force only until then.

fields.name: guardian_pause_ready_at
docs: The guardian may not pause again before this time (`GUARDIAN_PAUSE_COOLDOWN` after its last pause was due to
lapse).

types.name: CapacityConfigProposalResolved
docs: A pending config change was applied (`applied = true`) or dropped.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: After this the proposal can only be cancelled.

fields.name: paused_until
docs: When the pause lapses by itself (0 when `paused` is false).

types.name: CommitmentReleased
docs: A commitment was settled and its bond lock released without a report, after the claim period.

fields.name: amount
docs: Bonded USDC currently held in the vault and not yet slashed.

fields.name: unbond_at
docs: Unix time after which `withdraw_bond` is allowed; 0 = no unbond requested.

fields.name: strikes
docs: Number of executed slashes against this host.

fields.name: slashed_total
docs: Total USDC slashed over the life of the bond.

fields.name: open_proposals
docs: Proposals that are neither executed nor rejected.

fields.name: next_proposal_id
docs: Next proposal id to be assigned (ids are monotonically increasing).

fields.name: delisted
docs: Set by a quantization-swap or shadow-mismatch slash that took something (not by one the cumulative cap cut to
zero). Blocks new capacity commitments. Cleared only by the authority, through `propose_reinstate` and its
timelock.

fields.name: ejected
docs: Set by a shadow-mismatch slash that took something. Cleared the same way.

types.name: HostCapacity
docs: Per-host aggregate used to keep issuance bond-backed: the summed value of a host's open
commitments may never exceed its bonded amount.

types.name: HvxFeed
docs: HVX: hourly $/1M-token index per grade, built off-chain from wash-filtered receipts.
This account is a PUBLIC STATISTIC ONLY. It is write-only by `hvx_authority`, is never read
by any instruction in this program or in `trellis_bond`, and NOTHING SETTLES AGAINST IT:
shortfall refunds use `BushelLot.price_paid`, sales use `CapacityConfig.grade_prices`.

fields.name: hour
docs: Unix hour (unix_timestamp / 3600) the value refers to. Never ahead of the chain clock's hour and never going
back.

fields.name: usd_per_mtoken
docs: Index value in micro-USD per 1M output-equivalent tokens.

fields.name: thin
docs: True when the day's volume behind the index is below $50k.

fields.name: grade_prices
docs: USDC per Bushel for grades G-S, G-M, G-L.

types.name: LotRedeemed
docs: Credits of `grade` for `tokens` are issued off-chain to `key_hash` against this event.

types.name: LotShortfallClaimed
docs: `refund_amount = price_paid * unserved_tokens / committed_tokens`; filed against the host bond.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: A loosening config change waiting out `CONFIG_TIMELOCK`. PDA `["pending_config"]`; one at a time.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: The fields `update_config` / `propose_config` may change. `None` leaves a field as it is.

fields.name: new_authority
docs: Hand the authority over. Only through the timelock, and the new authority must sign the apply.
